Mock v2 · climate colours · 17 Oct 2026

Spain and region cards, with places coloured by climate

Places are coloured by their climate by default, with a legend. The map menu can switch back to study regions. The cards and the hover are as in v1. These are screenshots of the real app with the change built on a scratch branch, on the plain atlas map.

Before and after

Switch to study regions

A region and Rioja

Dark and iPad

What changed since v1

  • Colours mean climate: the Köppen class covering most of each place, in six groups: oceanic, humid with hot summers, Mediterranean with warm summers, Mediterranean with hot summers, dry with cold winters, and hot and dry. Six rather than five, so each group stays a real Köppen class.
  • Study region colours stay one tap away in the map menu.
  • The greyed-out "Climate (coming)" switch is gone from the menu, because it would mean nearly the same as "Colour places by Climate". The planned full climate layer would come back as a third choice there.
  • The legend sits under the mode bar, over the sea, so it covers no places.

Honest gaps

  • 30 smaller places (most Vinos de Pago, Cava, Catalunya, Islas Canarias) have no climate measured yet, so they show grey. The build would measure them from the same climate layer already in the repo.
  • The colours over satellite are not checked yet, because the cloud can't load satellite tiles.
  • The full design review (ReviewBot design mode and the style sheet check) runs on the version you approve, before it is built for real.
